description.value: Tim Hortons is a Canadian quick-service chain offering coffee, baked goods, soups, and breakfast wraps. This downtown Vancouver location sits in the West Pender Street business corridor and operates on weekdays only. It is a practical pit stop for cyclists moving through the downtown core who need a quick meal or beverage.
